seoTitle: Emergency Fund Calculator: How Much to Save
metaDescription: Work out an emergency fund target from essential monthly costs and months of cover, and how long it takes to reach it.
intro: Target emergency fund, the gap to your savings and the time to close it.
why:
An emergency fund covers essential costs if income stops. The usual guidance is three to six months, with more for a single income, variable income or dependants.

Enter only essentials, not wants. The tool shows how many months your current savings cover and how long saving a fixed amount takes, without counting interest.
howTo: Enter current savings and what you can add monthly.
